\begin{tikzpicture}[>=Stealth,scale=0.9]

\draw[black!30] (0,0) circle (1);
\draw[MidnightBlue,very thick,->] (0,0) -- (1.000,0.000);
\draw[ForestGreen!70!black,very thick,->] (0,0) -- (-0.500,0.866);
\draw[BrickRed,very thick,->] (0,0) -- (-0.500,-0.866);
\node[font=\scriptsize,anchor=north] at (0,-1.15) {$1+\omega^{1}+\omega^{2}=0$};
\node[font=\scriptsize,anchor=south] at (0,1.1) {$k=1$};
\end{scope}
\begin{scope}[xshift=3.6cm]
\draw[black!30] (0,0) circle (1);
\draw[MidnightBlue,very thick,->] (0,0) -- (1.000,0.000);

\draw[BrickRed,very thick,->] (0,0) -- (-0.500,0.866);
\node[font=\scriptsize,anchor=north] at (0,-1.15) {$1+\omega^{2}+\omega^{4}=0$};
\node[font=\scriptsize,anchor=south] at (0,1.1) {$k=2$};
\end{scope}
\begin{scope}[xshift=7.2cm]
\draw[black!30] (0,0) circle (1);
\draw[MidnightBlue,very thick,->] (0,0) -- (1.000,0.000);

\draw[BrickRed,very thick,->] (0,0) -- (1.000,-0.000);
\node[font=\scriptsize,anchor=north] at (0,-1.15) {$1+\omega^{3}+\omega^{6}=3$};
\node[font=\scriptsize,anchor=south] at (0,1.1) {$k=3$};

\end{tikzpicture}
